description: This file contains the server-side code for an online multiple-choice question (MCQ) examination page within an ASP.NET Web Forms application. It handles loading questions from a database, displaying them on the page, managing countdown timer, submitting answers, calculating scores, and navigating between pages.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Partial class representing the code-behind for the MCQ exam page, managing question loading, answer submission, timer countdown, and page navigation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization; loads questions from database based on session course, sets up timer, and displays questions when not postback.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the User Profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, records it in the database, and navigates to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles user logout by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display; triggers timeout handling when time expires.
